bib.title: COMPACTER: Efficient Low-Rank Hypercomplex Adapter Layers

question: How few trainable parameters does a pretrained language model need to match full fine-tuning on standard NLP benchmarks?
hypothesis: Adapter weights built from shared slow Kronecker factors and per-layer rank-one fast factors can match fine-tuning with O(k+d) parameters.
contributions: Systematic training time and memory evaluation of PEFT methods

method.summary: Adapters after attention and feed-forward blocks of frozen T5-base whose down/up projections are sum of n Kronecker products A_i (shared across layers) with B_i = s_i t_i^T (rank one, per adapter). Compacter++ keeps only the adapter after the feed-forward block. Compared to adapter, Pfeiffer, AdapterDrop, prompt tuning, Intrinsic-SAID, BitFit and full fine-tuning.
method.task: text-to-text classification/regression on GLUE and SuperGLUE

datasets.name: GLUE (no WNLI)
datasets.size: MNLI, QQP, QNLI, SST-2, CoLA, STS-B, MRPC, RTE; sizes not stated
datasets.split: 1k split from train for validation, original validation as test; datasets <10k samples: validation set halved into validation and test

datasets.name: SuperGLUE (BoolQ, CB, COPA, MultiRC, ReCoRD, WiC)

models.name: Compacter / Compacter++ / PHM-Adapter
models.architecture: LPHM adapters; adapter size {96,48,24}; n in {4,8,12}; rank r=1

training.lr: best of 3e-5,3e-4,3e-3,3e-2,3e-1 on validation; Compacter, Compacter++, PHM-Adapter, Adapter-LowRank 3e-3; T5-base, Adapter, Pfeiffer, AdapterDrop, BitFit 3e-4; Prompt tuning-R 3e-2, -T 3e-1; Intrinsic-SAID 3e-2 (Table 4)
training.warmup: 500 steps for GLUE (Tables 1, 7); 0 for SuperGLUE and T5-small
training.epochs: 3 on large datasets, 20 on low-resource GLUE datasets (MRPC, CoLA, STS-B, RTE, BoolQ, CB, COPA, WiC); subsampled: 1000,200,100,50,25 for sizes 100,500,1000,2000,4000
training.hardware: one NVIDIA GEFORCE RTX 3090 (Tables 1, 2, 9, and 3); one GTX 1080 Ti (low-resource)
training.wall_clock: Table 3: T5-base 42.13 min/epoch on MNLI, Compacter++ 30.96
training.seeds: single run per cell; prompt tuning with unstable cells restarted with 6 seeds, best reported; low-resource 5 seeds

other.frozen: pretrained weights and output layer frozen, layer norms trained
other.checkpoint: every epoch (every 250 steps in low-resource); best on validation reported
other.AdapterDrop: adapters dropped from first five layers of encoder and decoder

metrics.name: GLUE/SuperGLUE per-task
metrics.definition: accuracy; F1 for MRPC/QQP/CB/ReCoRD; Pearson/Spearman for STS-B; Matthews for CoLA; MultiRC F1a/EM; average over tasks

metrics.name: Memory and time/epoch
metrics.definition: peak memory and training time on 1 epoch MNLI

eval.protocol: Best checkpoint and hyperparameters per task chosen on validation; test is original validation set (halved for small sets); no error bars on main tables.

limits: Only T5-base and T5-small; larger models not run for compute cost
No LoRA baseline and LoRA not cited
Single run per cell, no error bars on Tables 1-2; best-on-validation selection
With T5-small all PEFT methods are below full fine-tuning
Layer norms and biases make up much of the trained parameters; normalization-free adaptation left to future work
Prompt tuning unstable; restarts with 6 seeds, best reported

terms.definition: low-rank parameterized hypercomplex multiplication layer: W = sum_i A_i (x) (s_i t_i^T)
